name: zmath_vec3_slerp
description: zMath::Vec3Slerp handles endpoint copies, near-linear interpolation, antiparallel perpendicular interpolation, and general spherical interpolation.
known_limits: Tier S remains blocked by the direct zMath::Vec3Perp2D dependency, which is still tier B with local VC5SP3 evidence blocked at 88 unmasked byte mismatches.

Local VC5SP3 comparison for zMath::Vec3Slerp is blocked: vc5_o2_ob0_md_facs leaves 614 unmasked byte mismatches because retail uses a larger EBP-frame x87 body with inlined dot math, stack temporaries, fsin/fcos/fsincos range handling including threshold 0x4d2940, and inline fast-sqrt estimate, while VC5 emits a shorter body with helper calls and different scheduling.
The general path intentionally uses the recovered fast square-root bit estimate for sin(omega) before atan2 and reciprocal scaling.
vc5_attempt: python tools/recoil.py verify vc5 0x472a10 --build-root build/vc5-verify-472a10-final (vc5_o2_ob0_md_facs blocked: 614 unmasked byte mismatches; source model is source-faithful, but zMath::Vec3Perp2D remains tier B and has its own VC5SP3 mismatch blocker)
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly for 0x472a10 validates ECX as the first input vector, EDX as the second input vector, stack arguments for t and output, exact t == 0 and t == 1 copy exits, dot-product thresholds at -0.95 and 0.95, the antiparallel Vec3Perp2D path using pi * t, the near-parallel linear blend, and the general atan2/sin weighted blend divided by the recovered sin(omega).
The native zMath smoke verifies endpoint copies, the near-parallel linear path, the antiparallel perpendicular path, and a representative quarter-turn spherical interpolation case.
